CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Laboratory

Patient: [redacted name]
DOB: [redacted date]
MRN: [redacted ID]
Specimen: Peripheral blood
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Down Syndrome investigation

TEST PERFORMED
G-banded chromosome analysis

PREVIOUS TESTING
This analysis supersedes the previous rapid PCR result reported on [redacted date]

RESULT
Karyotype: 46,XX

Normal female karyotype

No evidence of trisomy 21 or other significant chromosomal abnormalities detected.

METHODOLOGY
G-banded chromosome analysis was performed on cultured peripheral blood lymphocytes. A minimum of 20 metaphases were analyzed at a resolution of 400-550 bands. This analysis is sufficient to exclude numerical abnormalities and major structural rearrangements.

INTERPRETATION
The chromosome analysis shows a normal female karyotype with no evidence of Down syndrome or other detectable chromosomal abnormalities. This result excludes trisomy 21 and other common chromosomal causes of developmental delay.

LIMITATIONS
This analysis cannot detect subtle chromosomal rearrangements below the resolution of conventional cytogenetics, low-level mosaicism (<10%), or single gene disorders.

ADDITIONAL TESTING
Please note: Molecular testing for Sickle Cell Disease has been requested separately and results are pending from the reference laboratory. These results will be reported independently when available.

Reported by: [redacted name], Clinical Scientist
Authorized by: [redacted name], Consultant Clinical Geneticist
